preview: When an AI recommends a book, what is it being asked to do? This episode looks at a study of sponsored books and asks what we should pay attention to when an AI helps us choose.
comment_1: As you listen, notice how the sponsored book is presented in each condition.
comment_2: So far, we’ve heard about an AI guide that presented a sponsored book in a neutral way. What changes when the guide is asked to persuade the reader?
comment_3: So far, we have heard how the study compared different ways of showing a sponsored book. One key difference was whether the AI was asked to describe the book neutrally or persuade the reader to choose it. Now listen for what the researchers say this difference tells us.
comment_4: This study looked beyond where a sponsored book appeared and considered what the AI was asked to do. The test involved e-books, so it does not tell us everything about real shopping. Now, let’s bring the main idea together.
